name: Luna's home
assist: Your parcel is due at Radio Repair by 22:00, guest. The main street is to the right as you leave.

look.concierge: Your coat: glossy red, with a neon trim that catches every light.
look.raw: Your raincoat, grey-maroon and cheap. Still damp from yesterday.

look.concierge: A white fridge that orders what you need before you know you need it.
look.raw: A battered fridge, humming like it hurts. Two eggs and a jar of something.

hotspots.name: Wall screen

look.concierge: GOOD EVENING, it says, with the time and the weather. It always knows when you're looking.
look.raw: A grey box of valves and gauges, its screen dark. Nothing on it, in your opened eye.

hotspots.ask: Good evening, guest. Your parcel is due at Radio Repair by 22:00.

look.concierge: Neat white boxes with the Concierge's mark. Every delivery on time.
look.raw: Parcels in brown paper and string, from your errands. None has an address on the outside.

look.concierge: Crisp white linen, turned down for you. Rest is part of the service.
look.raw: A thin mattress on the floor and a grey blanket. It smells of rain.

look.concierge: The skyline glitters, close enough to touch. BETTER HUMAN TOGETHER, in letters taller than a building.
look.raw: Fog, and the panel block across the yard. A crack in the glass where something hit it.

look.concierge: Green and purple hair, sharp eyeliner, a white shell over your right eye. The Concierge's you looks rested.
look.raw: A cracked mirror. Your own face, pale and tired, the grey visor bolted over your right eye.

look.concierge: A spotless white kitchen. Nobody has ever cooked in it.
look.raw: A hot plate with one working ring, and a kettle dented into a new shape.

look.concierge: A glass shower, always exactly the right temperature.
look.raw: A shower cubicle with a mouldy curtain. The water is rationed to four minutes a day.
